name: Titanium.Stream
summary: Stream module containing stream utility methods.
description:
This module provides a set of methods for interacting with
[IOStream](api:Titanium.IOStream) objects, including asynchronous versions of the
`read` and `write` methods offered by all stream objects. These
methods should be used in any place where reading from or writing
to a stream might block.

See also:

* [Titanium.IOStream](api:Titanium.IOStream)
* [Titanium.BlobStream](api:Titanium.BlobStream)
* [Titanium.BufferStream](api:Titanium.BufferStream)
* [Titanium.Filesystem.FileStream](api:Titanium.Filesystem.FileStream)
* [Titanium.Network.Socket.TCP](api:Titanium.Network.Socket.TCP)

properties.name: MODE_APPEND
properties.summary:
Use with [createStream](api:Titanium.Stream#createStream) to open a stream in append
mode.

properties.name: MODE_READ
properties.summary:
Use with [createStream](api:Titanium.Stream#createStream) to open a stream in read
mode.

properties.name: MODE_WRITE
properties.summary:
Use with [createStream](api:Titanium.Stream#createStream) to open a stream in write
mode.

methods.name: createStream
methods.summary: Creates stream from a `Buffer` or `Blob` object.
methods.description:
Returns [Titanium.BufferStream](api:Titanium.BufferStream) or [Titanium.BlobStream](api:Titanium.BlobStream) depending on whether a
`Buffer` or `Blob` is provided as the `source` property in `params`.


`Blob` objects are read only. Throws an exception if `MODE_WRITE` or `MODE_APPEND` is
specified along with a blob object.

parameters.name: params
parameters.summary: Parameter object, for specifying the source object and mode.

properties.name: mode
properties.summary: Mode to open the stream in.

properties.name: source
properties.summary: Object that the stream will read from or write to.

methods.name: pump
methods.summary: Reads data from input stream and passes it to a handler method.
methods.description:
After the end of the input stream is reached, the handler is called
a final time with no data and `bytesProcessed` set to -1 to indicate
the end of the input data.

parameters.name: inputStream
parameters.summary: Stream to pump from.

parameters.name: handler
parameters.summary: Handler method that will receive data from `inputStream`.

inlined.name: PumpCallbackArgs
inlined.summary:
Argument passed to the callback each time the
[pump](api:Titanium.Stream#pump) operation has new data to deliver.
inlined.description:
A callback with `bytesProcessed` set to -1 indicates the end of the
pump operation, either because of an error or because the end of the
stream has been reached.

properties.name: buffer
properties.summary: Buffer object holding the data currently being pumped to the handler method.

properties.name: bytesProcessed
properties.summary:
Number of bytes being passed to this invocation of the handler, or
-1 in the event of an error or end of stream.

properties.name: code
properties.description:
Error code will be 0 if `success` is `true`, nonzero otherwise. If the error
was generated by the operating system, that system's error value is used.
Otherwise, this value will be -1.

properties.name: totalBytesProcessed
properties.summary:
Total number of bytes read from the stream so far,
including the data passed to this current invocation of the handler.

parameters.name: maxChunkSize
parameters.summary: Maximum number of bytes to pass to `handler` in a single call.

parameters.name: isAsync
parameters.summary: Specifies if the `pump` operation should run asynchronously.

methods.name: read
methods.summary: Asynchronously reads data from an [IOStream](api:Titanium.IOStream) into a buffer.
methods.description:
Reads data from the stream and writes it to the buffer. The first byte is
written to `buffer[offset]`. Reads until the provided buffer is full, the end of
the stream is detected, or the requested number of bytes have been read. Does not
resize the supplied buffer.

A request must include both `offset` and `length` parameters, or omit them both.

If the stream is not readable, an error is reported:

* On iOS, throws an exception.

* On Android, calls the callback with an error.

If `offset` is past the last byte of the buffer, throws an exception.

parameters.name: sourceStream
parameters.summary: Stream to read from.

parameters.name: buffer
parameters.summary: Buffer to read into.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.summary:
Offset to start reading stream data from, in bytes.
If specified, `length` must be specified as well.

parameters.name: length
parameters.summary:
Number of bytes of data to read from the stream.
If specified, `offset` must be specified as well.
parameters.default: All available data or the length of the buffer, whichever is smaller.

parameters.name: resultsCallback
parameters.summary: Function to call with the results of the read operation.

methods.name: readAll
methods.summary: Reads all data from the specified [IOStream](api:Titanium.IOStream).
methods.description:
Reads data from the stream, either synchronously or asynchronously.

Throws an exception if a read error is encountered or data can't be written to the
buffer.

If the optional `buffer` and `resultsCallback` arguments are specified, the read operation
takes place asynchronously, and the results are passed to the callback.
The data is written to the provided buffer, which is resized if necessary.

If the `buffer` and `resultsCallback` arguments are omitted, a new buffer is
allocated and returned.

parameters.name: sourceStream
parameters.summary: Stream to read from.

parameters.name: buffer
parameters.summary:
Buffer to read into. If specified, `resultsCallback` must be specified as
well.

parameters.name: resultsCallback
parameters.summary:
Function to call with the results of the read operation.
If specified, `resultsCallback` must be specified as well.

methods.name: write
methods.summary: Asynchronously writes data from a buffer to an [IOStream](api:Titanium.IOStream).
methods.description:
Data is read from the buffer and written to the stream.

If the `offset` and `length` arguments are specified, data is read from the buffer
starting at `offset`, up to `offset+length-1` or the end of the buffer, whichever
comes first.

If `offset` and `length` are omitted, the entire buffer is written to the stream.

If the output stream is not writable, an error is reported:

* On iOS, an exception is thrown.

* On Android, the callback is invoked with an error.

parameters.name: outputStream
parameters.summary: Stream to write to.

parameters.name: buffer
parameters.summary: Buffer to write from.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.summary:
Offset to start writing buffer data from.
If specified, `length` must be specified as well.

parameters.name: length
parameters.summary: Bytes of data to write. If specified, `offset` must be specified as well.

parameters.name: resultsCallback
parameters.summary: Function to call with the results of the write operation.

methods.name: writeStream
methods.summary: Writes all data from an input stream to an output stream.
methods.description:
If the optional `resultsCallback` argument is supplied, the operation is
performed asynchronously.

If the callback is omitted, this method is synchronous, and blocks until all data has been written.
The synchronous version Returns the total number of bytes written.

If no data can be read from the input stream because the input
stream is at end of stream, behavior varies by platform:

*   iOS throws an exception.

*   Android returns 0, or calls the callback with `bytesProcessed` set to 0.

parameters.name: inputStream
parameters.summary: Stream to read from.

parameters.name: outputStream
parameters.summary: Stream to write to.

parameters.name: maxChunkSize
parameters.summary:
Maximum number of bytes to copy from `inputStream` to `outputStream` in a
single operation.

parameters.name: resultsCallback
parameters.summary: Function to call with the results of the `writeStream` operation.

inlined.name: WriteStreamCallbackArgs
inlined.summary:
Argument passed to the callback when an asynchronous
[writeStream](api:Titanium.Stream#writeStream) operation finishes.

properties.name: bytesProcessed
properties.summary: Number of bytes processed, or -1 in the event of an error or end of stream.
